Ignite is a Damage Over Time Status which can also be applied on hit based on Ignite Chance or through various skills.

Ignite damage is not considered a hit and cannot trigger any on hit effects in Combat Calculations, such as Critical Strike Chance.

## Scaling[]

Ignite's Damage scales with the following:

- Increased Damage

- Fire Damage

- Elemental Damage

- Damage over Time

- Ignite Effect

Spell Damage does not affect Ignite.

## Description[]

Ignite deals Fire Damage over 3 seconds. An enemy can have multiple instances of Ignite at once.

The base ignite damage is 40 (over 3 seconds).

## Sources of Ignite[]

- Ignite Chance
